help.text:
usage: faraday-cli [-h] [command] ...

Commands as arguments

positional arguments:
  command       optional command to run, if no command given, enter an
                interactive shell
  command_args  optional arguments for command

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit

--advanced-filters.help: Use custom filter in json format

--create-workspace.help: Create the workspace it not exists

--force.help: Process the output of the command regardless of the results

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--label-before.help: Display the values before the bars

--max-severity.help: Maximum severity of vulnerabilities to import

--min-severity.help: Minimum severity of vulnerabilities to import

--no-interaction.help: Skips user interaction for list pages

--no-labels.help: Do not print the label column

--no-values.help: Do not print the values at end

--pretty.help: Show table in a pretty format

--status.help: Status of the vuln: open, closed, re-opened, risk-accepted

--suffix.help: string to add as a suffix to all data points.

--width.help: width of graph in characters default:50

filename.help: data file name (comma or space separated). Defaults to stdin.
